mapper.select: SELECT b.board_no, b.board_title, b.board_content, b.board_reg_date, b.board_view_cnt, b.user_no, f.file_no, f.file_name, f.file_path, f.file_system_name FROM board b LEFT JOIN files f ON b.board_no = f.board_no WHERE b.board_no = #{no}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO board (board_title, board_content, user_no) VALUES (#{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{userNo})
INSERT INTO files(file_no, file_name, file_path, file_system_name, board_no) VALUES (#{fileNo}, #{oriName}, #{path}, #{systemName}, #{boardNo});
